status: frozen before execution (redrafted 2026-10-08; user: 'sure go ahead'; frozen before mode detection or any Phase-1e training)
question: Can the training rebalancing that lifted the monitor (arm R) be done WITHOUT task labels or simulator state, by oversampling the rare outcome mode found by the goal-free split test on each training state's own real futures?
basis: Phase 1d: arm R (50% toppling futures per batch, chosen with Jenga topple labels) 74.7% / 4.7% on H, 79.1% / 7.5% on fresh panel 7, vs cell E 69.3% / 8.2% and 71.6% / 7.5%. The monitor is label-free at run time, but R's training used a task-specific label; this protocol tests a task-agnostic replacement.
mode_detection: for every training state (Phase-1 enriched data: 4,766 states, 8 or 16 real futures each), apply the unchanged split test (persistent_mode_alarm) to the real futures' latents at hold 10 and hold 30. If it alarms, the smaller hold-30 group is the state's RARE MODE and the other futures its MAJORITY MODE; otherwise all futures are 'no split'. Uses only image latents: no topple label, no block state, no task knowledge. Topple labels are used afterwards ONLY to report how rare modes relate to topples (descriptive).
base_recipe: cell E exactly (30,000 steps, seed 0), differing only in how futures are sampled into batches

arms.U_unsupervised: 50% of every batch drawn uniformly from rare-mode futures, 50% uniformly from all other futures (majority and no-split)
arms.US_siblings: 50% rare-mode futures; the other 50% drawn from the majority mode of states that have a rare mode (the sibling branch of the same start)

references: cell E (no rebalancing) and arm R (label-based rebalancing), both already evaluated through the same code path
evaluation_on_H: as Phase 1d: R0 and R1 (each model's own validation-error floor), lean/contact catch rates (frozen 10-deg rule; reporting only), side agreement
selection_rule: rank U and US by (forks caught - false alarms) under R0 on H; report beside E and R
held_out_check: the better of U and US on panel 7, graded as Phase 1d addendum 1 (descriptive; panel 7 does not choose between arms)
success_reading: U or US 'matches R' if its H score (caught - false) is within 0.03 of R's (0.700); then the rebalancing result can be stated as task-agnostic
gate_for_panel_6: unchanged: >= 80% of H forks caught with <= 20% false alarms (R0); a fresh panel 6 would be generated only after asking
out_of_scope: the fork-rich DATA SELECTION behind cell E (screened with topple counts) is also label-based; a label-free version (screen scenes whose real futures split) is a separate, later protocol
budget: mode detection ~10 min; U and US ~2.5 h each, one at a time; evaluation minutes
